translations.EN: Food would help, but I don't have an exact amount yet.
translations.TL: Makakatulong ang pagkain, pero wala akong eksaktong dami ngayon.

translations.EN: Any food you could spare would make a difference.
translations.TL: Kahit anong pagkaing maibibigay mo ay malaking tulong.

translations.EN: I'm definitely hungry. Whatever rations you have would be welcome.
translations.TL: Gutom na talaga ako. Anumang rasyon mayroon ka ay tatanggapin ko.

translations.EN: A meal would be great, even if it's just something small.
translations.TL: Maganda sanang makakain, kahit kaunti lang.

translations.EN: I could really use some food right now.
translations.TL: Kailangang-kailangan ko talaga ng pagkain ngayon.

translations.EN: My stomach is empty. Any edible supplies would help.
translations.TL: Walang laman ang tiyan ko. Makakatulong ang anumang makakain.

translations.EN: Food would keep me on my feet. I'll take whatever you offer.
translations.TL: Pagkain ang magpapanatili sa akin sa labas. Tatanggapin ko ang iaalok mo.

translations.EN: Running low on food out here. Appreciate whatever you can share.
translations.TL: Nauubusan na ako ng pagkain. Salamat sa anumang maibabahagi mo.

translations.EN: Haven't eaten a decent bite today. Food would go a long way.
translations.TL: Hindi pa ako kumakain nang maayos ngayon. Malaking tulong ang pagkain.

translations.EN: Could use rations soon. Let's see what you've got.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng rasyon agad. Tingnan natin kung anong mayroon ka.

translations.EN: Food would help, if you can spare it.
translations.TL: Makakatulong ang pagkain, kung may maibibigay ka.

translations.EN: I'd truly appreciate a bite to eat, friend, if you have extra.
translations.TL: Lubos kong pasasalamatan ang makakain, kaibigan, kung may sobra ka.

translations.EN: You're very kind to offer. Some food would really lift my spirits.
translations.TL: Napakabait mong mag-alok. Talagang magpapagaan ng loob ko ang pagkain.

translations.EN: I could definitely use a meal. Thank you for thinking of me.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko nga ng makakain. Salamat sa pag-alala sa akin.

translations.EN: Sharing rations is generous out here. I'd be grateful for anything.
translations.TL: Napakabuting magbahagi ng rasyon dito. Masaya ako sa kahit ano.

translations.EN: A bit of food would mean the world right now, thank you.
translations.TL: Napakalaking bagay ng kahit kaunting pagkain ngayon, salamat.

translations.EN: If you've got food to share, I won't say no. You're a lifesaver.
translations.TL: Kung may maibabahagi kang pagkain, tatanggapin ko. Ligtas ako sa 'yo.

translations.EN: I'm hungry, and your generosity means a lot. Thank you.
translations.TL: Gutom ako, at malaking bagay ang kabaitan mo. Salamat.

translations.EN: Happy to accept any food you can spare. Let's eat together.
translations.TL: Masayang tatanggapin ang anumang sobra mo. Sabay tayong kumain.

translations.EN: Thank you for asking. A warm meal or small ration would be wonderful.
translations.TL: Salamat sa pagtatanong. Napakaganda sana ng kahit simpleng pagkain.

translations.EN: I need food.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng pagkain.

translations.EN: Hungry.
translations.TL: Gutom.

translations.EN: Got food?
translations.TL: May pagkain?

translations.EN: Need rations.
translations.TL: Kailangan ng rasyon.

translations.EN: Food helps.
translations.TL: Makatutulong ang pagkain.

translations.EN: Starving.
translations.TL: Gutom na gutom.

translations.EN: Spare a bite.
translations.TL: Penge ng pagkain.

translations.EN: Any cans?
translations.TL: May de-lata?

translations.EN: Food. Please.
translations.TL: Pagkain. Pakiusap.

translations.EN: Empty stomach.
translations.TL: Walang laman ang tiyan.

translations.EN: I need food. Keep your distance.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng pagkain. Lumayo ka.

translations.EN: If that food has strings attached, forget it.
translations.TL: Kung may kapalit ang pagkaing 'yan, huwag na lang.

translations.EN: I'm hungry, but don't try anything funny.
translations.TL: Gutom ako, pero huwag kang magtangkang manloko.

translations.EN: Put the food down on the ground and step back.
translations.TL: Ilapag mo ang pagkain sa lupa at umatras ka.

translations.EN: I could use rations, but I won't owe you my life.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng rasyon, pero hindi ko ibebenta ang sarili ko.

translations.EN: Is that sealed? I don't take spoiled or poisoned rations.
translations.TL: Selyado ba 'yan? Hindi ako kumakain ng panis o may lason.

translations.EN: I need food, but keep your hands where I can see them.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng pagkain, pero ilagay ang kamay sa kita ko.

translations.EN: Only take what you're offering freely. No hidden deals.
translations.TL: Kukunin ko lang kung bukal sa loob. Walang tagong kasunduan.

translations.EN: I'm starving, but I'm still armed. Remember that.
translations.TL: Gutom ako, pero may armas pa rin ako. Tandaan mo 'yan.

translations.EN: Leave the supplies right there. No sudden moves.
translations.TL: Iwan mo ang gamit diyan. Walang biglaang galaw.

translations.EN: Water would help, but I don't have an exact amount yet.
translations.TL: Makakatulong ang tubig, pero wala akong eksaktong dami ngayon.

translations.EN: I could really use a clean drink of water.
translations.TL: Kailangang-kailangan ko talaga ng malinis na maiinom na tubig.

translations.EN: Any spare water you have would be a big relief.
translations.TL: Anumang sobrang tubig na mayroon ka ay malaking ginhawa.

translations.EN: Thirsty as can be. A bottle or canteen would help.
translations.TL: Uhaw na uhaw ako. Makakatulong ang botelya o lalagyan.

translations.EN: My throat is completely parched. Water would do wonders.
translations.TL: Tuyong-tuyo na ang lalamunan ko. Malaking tulong ang tubig.

translations.EN: Need water soon before dehydration sets in.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng tubig bago ako maubusan ng likido.

translations.EN: If you've got extra water on you, I'll take it.
translations.TL: Kung may sobra kang tubig sa bag mo, kukunin ko.

translations.EN: A few sips of clean water would keep me walking.
translations.TL: Ilang lagok ng malinis na tubig ang magpapatuloy sa akin.

translations.EN: Desperate for a drink today. Anything you can spare?
translations.TL: Uhaw na uhaw ako ngayong araw. May maibibigay ka ba?

translations.EN: Fresh water is life out here. I'd gladly take some.
translations.TL: Buhay ang malinis na tubig dito. Masaya akong tatanggap.

translations.EN: A little rest would help, but this isn't something I can count.
translations.TL: Makakatulong ang kaunting pahinga, pero hindi ito mabibilang.

translations.EN: What I really need is a safe place to shut my eyes.
translations.TL: Ang kailangan ko talaga ay ligtas na lugar para makatulog.

translations.EN: Just need some downtime to recover my energy.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko lang ng kaunting pahinga para bumalik ang lakas ko.

translations.EN: Rest is the only cure for this exhaustion right now.
translations.TL: Pahinga lang ang makakapagpagaling sa pagod na ito.

translations.EN: If we can find a secure spot, a nap would do me good.
translations.TL: Kung makakahanap tayo ng ligtas na sulok, makakatulong ang idlip.

translations.EN: Fatigue is catching up. I just need a safe corner to rest.
translations.TL: Inaabutan na ako ng antok. Kailangan ko lang ng ligtas na sulok.

translations.EN: No item can fix this tiredness. I just need to sleep.
translations.TL: Walang gamit ang makakagamot sa pagod na 'to. Tulog lang kailangan ko.

translations.EN: Could use a couple hours off my feet, honestly.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng ilang oras na hindi nakatayo, sa totoo lang.

translations.EN: Need to recharge my batteries before we do anything risky.
translations.TL: Kailangang makabawi ng lakas bago tayo gumawa ng mapanganib.

translations.EN: Time to rest would be the greatest gift right now.
translations.TL: Oras para magpahinga ang pinakamagandang maitutulong ngayon.

translations.EN: I don't know what I need right now.
translations.TL: Hindi ko alam kung ano ang kailangan ko ngayon.

translations.EN: Hard to say what would help most at the moment.
translations.TL: Mahirap sabihin kung ano ang pinakakailangan sa ngayon.

translations.EN: Not entirely sure what supplies I'm missing yet.
translations.TL: Hindi pa ako sigurado kung anong gamit ang kulang sa akin.

translations.EN: Need a minute to take inventory of my situation.
translations.TL: Kailangan ko ng sandali para alamin ang sitwasyon ko.

translations.EN: Can't pinpoint what I need right now. Let me check my bag.
translations.TL: Hindi ko masabi kung anong kailangan ngayon. Tingnan ko muna gamit ko.

translations.EN: Nothing specific comes to mind right this second.
translations.TL: Walang partikular na pumapasok sa isip ko sa ngayon.

translations.EN: Unsure. Let me get my thoughts together first.
translations.TL: Hindi sigurado. Ayusin ko muna ang mga iniisip ko.

translations.EN: I'm okay for now, or at least nothing urgent stands out.
translations.TL: Maayos pa naman sa ngayon, o walang agarang kailangan.

translations.EN: Not sure what to ask for. What do you have available?
translations.TL: Hindi ko alam kung anong hihingin. Anong mayroon ka?

translations.EN: Can't tell what would help most right now. Ask me later.
translations.TL: Hindi ko masabi kung anong makakatulong ngayon. Tanungin mo ako mamaya.

translations.EN: I know food is what I need, but I can't give you an exact amount yet.
translations.TL: Alam kong pagkain ang kailangan ko, pero hindi ko pa masabi ang eksaktong dami.

translations.EN: Whatever you can spare to eat would be plenty.
translations.TL: Kahit anong maibibigay mong makakain ay sapat na.

translations.EN: Even one can or a couple rations would keep me going.
translations.TL: Kahit isang de-lata o dalawang rasyon ay malaking tulong na.

translations.EN: I'm not picky about the portion size, just need food.
translations.TL: Hindi ako mapili sa dami, basta may makakain lang.

translations.EN: A small portion or a full meal, anything helps.
translations.TL: Maliit man o buong pagkain, lahat 'yon makakatulong.

translations.EN: Just enough food to fill the hollow feeling in my gut.
translations.TL: Sapat lang na pagkain para mapawi ang gutom ko.

translations.EN: Don't need a banquet, just whatever food you're willing to share.
translations.TL: Hindi kailangan ng marami, kung ano lang ang kaya mong ibahagi.

translations.EN: A couple bites would buy me a few more hours of strength.
translations.TL: Ilang subo lang ay magbibigay sa akin ng ilang oras na lakas.

translations.EN: Hard to name a count. Just give me what you don't need.
translations.TL: Mahirap magbilang. Ibigay mo lang kung anong hindi mo kailangan.

translations.EN: Any amount of food is better than nothing right now.
translations.TL: Anumang dami ng pagkain ay mas maganda kaysa sa wala ngayon.

translations.EN: I know water is what I need, but I can't give you an exact amount yet.
translations.TL: Alam kong tubig ang kailangan ko, pero hindi ko pa masabi ang eksaktong dami.

translations.EN: Even half a bottle of water would make a difference.
translations.TL: Kahit kalahating botelya ng tubig ay malaking tulong na.

translations.EN: Just enough clean water to wet my throat, please.
translations.TL: Sapat lang na malinis na tubig pambasa ng lalamunan ko.

translations.EN: A single flask or a few gulps would be fantastic.
translations.TL: Kahit isang lagayan o ilang lagok ay napakaganda na.

translations.EN: I'm parched. Any amount of safe water would help.
translations.TL: Uhaw ako. Anumang dami ng ligtas na tubig ay makakatulong.

translations.EN: Don't need a whole gallon, just enough to stay hydrated.
translations.TL: Hindi kailangan ng galon, sapat lang para mawala ang uhaw.

translations.EN: Whatever water you can afford to part with right now.
translations.TL: Anumang tubig na kaya mong ibigay sa ngayon.

translations.EN: A cup or a bottle, I won't turn it down.
translations.TL: Kahit tasa o botelya, hindi ko tatanggihan.

translations.EN: Enough water to get through the afternoon would be great.
translations.TL: Sapat na tubig para maitawid ang hapon ay ayos na.

translations.EN: Just a small sip or two to keep my strength up.
translations.TL: Kahit isa o dalawang lagok lang para manatili ang lakas.

translations.EN: I can't confirm an exact amount yet. Which item do you mean?
translations.TL: Hindi ko makumpirma ang eksaktong dami. Anong gamit ang tinutukoy mo?

translations.EN: Tell me what item you're talking about first, then we can talk quantity.
translations.TL: Sabihin mo muna kung anong gamit, bago natin pag-usapan ang dami.

translations.EN: Depends on what you have. Which supply are we discussing?
translations.TL: Depende sa mayroon ka. Anong gamit ba ang pinag-uusapan natin?

translations.EN: Hard to give a number without knowing what item you're offering.
translations.TL: Mahirap magbigay ng bilang nang hindi alam kung ano ang iaalok mo.

translations.EN: What specific item do you have in mind to trade or share?
translations.TL: Anong partikular na gamit ang balak mong ibahagi o ipagpalit?

translations.EN: Let me know what you're holding before I name an amount.
translations.TL: Ipaalam mo muna kung anong hawak mo bago ako magbigay ng dami.

translations.EN: Which supply are we discussing? I need details first.
translations.TL: Anong gamit ang tinutukoy natin? Kailangan ko ng detalye muna.

translations.EN: Can't tell you how many until I know what it is.
translations.TL: Hindi ko masasabi kung ilan hangga't hindi ko alam kung ano 'yon.

translations.EN: What kind of gear or supplies are we talking about here?
translations.TL: Anong uri ng kagamitan o suplay ang pinag-uusapan natin dito?

translations.EN: Specify the item first, and then I'll let you know how much I need.
translations.TL: Tukuyin mo muna ang gamit, at sasabihin ko kung gaano karami ang kailangan ko.

translations.EN: I can keep that as a proposal, but I still need the item and amount before I record a commitment.
translations.TL: Ituturing ko muna itong panukala, pero kailangan ko pa ang gamit at dami bago ako magtala ng pangako.

translations.EN: Sounds like a fair idea for food, but let's confirm what and how much first.
translations.TL: Mukhang magandang ideya para sa pagkain, pero tiyakin muna natin kung ano at gaano karami.

translations.EN: I'm interested in the food offer, but let's settle on the exact details.
translations.TL: Interesado ako sa alok na pagkain, pero linawin natin ang mga detalye.

translations.EN: We can make a deal for food, just let me know the specifics.
translations.TL: Puwede tayong magkasundo sa pagkain, sabihin mo lang ang mga detalye.

translations.EN: Food trade sounds promising. What rations are we looking at exactly?
translations.TL: Mukhang maganda ang palitan ng pagkain. Anong rasyon ba eksakto ang tinitingnan natin?

translations.EN: I hear your proposal on food. Let's agree on portions before shaking on it.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang alok mo sa pagkain. Magkasundo muna tayo sa dami bago natin pagtibayin.

translations.EN: Could work for food, but we need to pin down the details first.
translations.TL: Puwede sa pagkain, pero kailangan nating tiyakin ang detalye muna.

translations.EN: I'm open to trading for food. Just tell me what items you have in mind.
translations.TL: Bukas ako sa pakikipagpalitan ng pagkain. Sabihin mo lang anong gamit ang nasa isip mo.

translations.EN: A food arrangement sounds good. Let's confirm what's on the table.
translations.TL: Maganda ang kasunduan sa pagkain. Tiyakin natin kung ano ang iaalok.

translations.EN: That food proposal works for me once we iron out the amount.
translations.TL: Ayos sa akin ang alok sa pagkain kapag naitama na natin ang dami.

translations.EN: I can keep that as a proposal, but I still need the item and amount before I record a commitment.
translations.TL: Ituturing ko muna itong panukala, pero kailangan ko pa ang gamit at dami bago ako magtala ng pangako.

translations.EN: Sounds like a solid idea for water, but let's confirm the bottles and amount first.
translations.TL: Mukhang maayos na plano para sa tubig, pero tiyakin muna natin ang botelya at dami.

translations.EN: I'm open to that water proposal. Just tell me how much you're offering.
translations.TL: Bukas ako sa alok na tubig. Sabihin mo lang kung gaano karami ang ibibigay mo.

translations.EN: We can agree on water, but let's nail down the specifics first.
translations.TL: Puwede tayong magkasundo sa tubig, pero ayusin muna natin ang detalye.

translations.EN: Water trade sounds good to me. What containers are we discussing?
translations.TL: Maganda ang palitan ng tubig. Anong lalagyan ba ang pinag-uusapan natin?

translations.EN: I hear your water offer. Let's agree on the quantity before finalizing.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang alok mong tubig. Magkasundo muna tayo sa dami bago tapusin.

translations.EN: Water is always valuable. Tell me the exact amount you want to trade.
translations.TL: Mahalaga palagi ang tubig. Sabihin mo ang eksaktong dami na nais mong ipagpalit.

translations.EN: I'd take that water deal once we clarify how much you're providing.
translations.TL: Tatanggapin ko ang kasunduan sa tubig kapag nalinaw na kung gaano karami ang ibibigay mo.

translations.EN: Good proposal for water. Let's make sure the details are clear to both of us.
translations.TL: Magandang alok para sa tubig. Siguraduhin nating malinaw ang detalye sa ating dalawa.

translations.EN: I'm ready to agree on water, just specify how many bottles or sips.
translations.TL: Handa akong sumang-ayon sa tubig, tukuyin mo lang kung ilang botelya o lagok.

translations.EN: I can keep that as a proposal, but I need to confirm the item and amount before I record a commitment.
translations.TL: Ituturing ko muna itong panukala, pero kailangan ko munang tiyakin ang gamit at dami bago ako magtala ng pangako.

translations.EN: Sounds like an interesting idea, but let's specify the supplies and amount first.
translations.TL: Mukhang kawili-wiling ideya, pero tukuyin muna natin ang gamit at dami.

translations.EN: I'm open to discussion, but I need to know what you're actually offering.
translations.TL: Bukas ako sa pag-uusap, pero kailangan kong malaman kung ano talaga ang iaalok mo.

translations.EN: We can make an arrangement once the items and quantities are clear.
translations.TL: Puwede tayong gumawa ng kasunduan kapag malinaw na ang mga gamit at dami.

translations.EN: I hear the proposal, but let's put concrete numbers on the table.
translations.TL: Narinig ko ang alok, pero maglagay tayo ng tiyak na bilang.

translations.EN: Happy to consider a trade, just spell out what you're putting forward.
translations.TL: Masayang pag-isipan ang palitan, sabihin mo lang nang malinaw ang ihahain mo.

translations.EN: Let's iron out what items we're talking about before making any promises.
translations.TL: Linawin muna natin kung anong gamit ang tinutukoy bago mangako.

translations.EN: I'm listening, but I need specific supplies and numbers to agree.
translations.TL: Nakikinig ako, pero kailangan ko ng partikular na suplay at bilang para pumayag.

translations.EN: A proposal is fine, but we need clear terms before shaking on it.
translations.TL: Maayos ang panukala, pero kailangan natin ng malinaw na kondisyon bago pagkasunduan.

translations.EN: Tell me what items and how many, and we'll see if we have a deal.
translations.TL: Sabihin mo kung anong gamit at ilan, at titingnan natin kung magkakasundo tayo.
